_readme: Marketing /tools/{slug} landing pages that 301 to the live tool on app.neramclasses.com. A slug redirects only when it is listed in `enabled`. Enable one only after (1) a Search Console export of 90 days of clicks for that URL is reviewed, (2) the app page has been indexed for 4 weeks, (3) the app page covers what this page offers. Remove the slug from `enabled` to roll back. ai-chatbot stays on marketing.
